tools.name: generate_mural_mockups
tools.title: Generate mural mockups
tools.description: Render photorealistic mural mockups: one per artwork (separate), all artworks in one mural (combined), or one artwork on 1-3 wall photos (multiwall).

artworkUrls.description: 1-3 public HTTPS URLs of artwork images. One mockup is rendered per artwork.

wallUrl.description: Optional public HTTPS URL of a wall photo to use as the background plate for every mockup.

wallUrls.description: 1-3 public HTTPS URLs of wall photos for 'multiwall' mode. One mockup per wall.

variant.description: 'base' for default composition, 'retry' to recompose lighting/angle.

mode.description: 'separate' renders one mural per artwork; 'combined' incorporates all artworks into a single mural; 'multiwall' paints the first artwork on each wall in wallUrls.

count.description: Number of mockups to render in 'combined' mode (ignored in 'separate' mode).
